traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: Data taken from Table 5 (page 6), which presents per-category totals (rows labeled 'Total' under each of the 6 categories: Composite foods, Meat products, Milk & Dairy products, Vegetables, Fish and seafood, Environmental samples). Sub-category rows (a, b, c) within each category were omitted per instructions, keeping only the category-level 'Total' rows. The overall 'Total' row (137/320/43/42...) aggregating all 6 categories was excluded as it is a grand total, not a category. Note: this report also contains a separate Interlaboratory study (section 4) with its own sensitivity/AC/FP values (SEalt=87%, SEref=89%, AC=77%, FP=33%) and RLOD/LOD tables (Tables 17-18, 30) with an Acceptability Limit of 2.5 log-equivalent RLOD units; these belong to a different study component (interlaboratory/RLOD) and were not included in the per-category method-comparison table above, as requested only the primary method comparison study table (Table 5/6) was recorded.
